summary: This specification defines a profile for issuing OAuth 2.0 access tokens in JSON Web Token (JWT) format. Authorization servers and resource servers from different vendors can follow it to issue and consume access tokens in an interoperable manner.

eli5.summary: An access token is like a ticket that lets you into a ride. This document says exactly how to write the ticket in a standard format, so rides made by different companies can all read it.

questions: jwt profile for oauth 2.0 access tokens
how to issue jwt access tokens
